design.predictor: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=1000; Beta(1,1) constant on single-class contexts
design.endpoint: realized one-query mean binary Brier improvement relative to the entropy policy
design.calibration: one-sided rank of predicted minus observed improvement for a frozen greedy meta policy; entropy has exactly zero contrast
design.data_access: development labels fit the meta predictor; calibration labels set the radius only; test candidate and target labels are used after all decisions
design.unit: episode seed conditional on a fixed empirical dataset; rows disjoint within episodes, overlaps across episodes retained; no domain/patient-population claim
design.inference: fresh classical inference for every episode; all static rules share exactly the same inference
